newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 9.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 10 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Local authorities in the Primorsky region in the Russian Far East orchestrate a campaign of popular support for governor Yevgeny Nazdratenko, who seems to be slowly but steadily being edged out of power by Moscow.
- Former Russian ambassador to London Anatoly Adamishin, relieved of this post last week, did not criticise Moscow's stance on NATO expansion, as was suggested in a recent television report.
- Russia has successfully launched a spy satellite just in time for the Le Bourget air show in France.
- The State Property Committee has promised to bring an additional five trillion roubles (about $1 billion) into the state budget in 1998 on top of the planned figures.
- A group of experts from Russia's giant natural gas monopoly Gazprom will go to Israel in July to start work on a joint project.
